description.en: A strange seed was planted on its back at birth. The plant sprouts and grows with this Pokémon.
description.zh_cn: 据说在它出生的时候，背上就种有一个会和它身体一同成长的神奇种子。

description.en: The target is physically pounded with a long tail, a foreleg, or the like.
description.zh_cn: 使用长长的尾巴或手等拍打对手进行攻击。

description.en: The best Poké Ball with the ultimate level of performance. With it, you will catch any wild Pokémon without fail.
description.zh_cn: 必定能捉到野生宝可梦的，性能最好的球。

description.en: The Pokémon makes it rain when it enters a battle.
description.zh_cn: 出场时，会将天气变为下雨。
